text_block_list.text:
"One day, after racing through countless 
contests and casting countless spells 
together with Sweep Tosho."

On our way to the hot springs won from the 
shopping district raffle, Sweep Tosho and 
I swayed together on the train.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure you didn't want to go to an 
amusement park instead?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Well, hot springs are supposed to be 
great for fatigue. We can go to the 
amusement park anytime anyway..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...Why not? I changed my mind! More 
importantly, aren't we going to get there 
soon?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I know, I'll use magic to make the train 
go faster! "Dash through the fleeting 
moments! Alstroemeria☆"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, familiar, assist me in strengthening 
my spell! First, retrieve the playing 
cards from my luggage!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've got them out—we're playing, 
of course! Heh-heh. Just so you know, I'm 
pretty good at this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come on, come on, is the Joker in my right 
hand or left hand~? It's written all over 
your face, Familiar~!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Hey, familiar! Making a funny face 
to play it off is totally against the 
rules!

The fun times passed in the blink of an 
eye, almost like magic—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
See? We arrived while we were playing! 
Right? The magic worked like a charm!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, so this is where we're staying 
today. Familiar! We're going to explore 
every corner of this inn!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! To book a ryokan this spacious, 
that shopping district really outdid 
themselves!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The bath is huge too, right!? I wonder if 
I can swim! And I want to check out the 
arcade corner, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There's still so much I haven't seen! I'm 
gonna explore inside the building a little 
more!
choice_data_list: Make sure you don't get lost!
Make sure you don't get lost!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No it won't—!

—It seemed I had fallen asleep before I 
knew it. Perhaps fatigue from recent days 
had caught up with me.

I knocked on the neighboring room's door, 
but Sweep Tosho didn't seem to have 
returned. I decided to go look for her.
In the bath...

As I walked through the inn, Sweep Tosho 
was just coming out of the changing room.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aah, you're finally awake! You were 
snoring away like an idiot, so I went 
ahead and took a bath first!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...? What's your problem? What's with that 
face? You look weird!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Who are you calling lost?!! When I 
went out of my way to—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That does it! I'm going back to my room!! 
You go take a bath and cool your head off!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I don't care! Idiot!

Taking a bath felt like it would only heat 
her head up even more, but... for now, I 
decided to chase after her!
(Knock knock knock!)

I knock, but get no answer. Having no 
choice, I quietly open the door—
(POOF!!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft... Ahahaha! Familiar, you look so 
goofy!"

It seems the moment the door was opened, a 
pillow came flying right at them...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Pillow fights are a staple of staying at 
an inn! Here, let me give you another one!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Eeek, the familiar got mad! Not 
scary at all, though!

After playing around to our hearts' 
content, we had dinner and finally decided 
to take the bath we'd put off earlier.

"...Come to think of it, Sweep Tosho was 
unusually well-behaved today."

Waking up early to catch the train, the 
walk from the Academy to the station—

Even on the train where she couldn't 
easily find a seat, she didn't throw any 
big tantrums.

And without waking me up as I slept, she 
took a proper bath all by herself— and 
once back in the room, played in high 
spirits.

Even though she'd said an amusement park 
was better than a hot spring when drawing 
the raffle ticket, she was the one who 
brought up going to a hot spring in the 
first place.

Without a doubt, she was caring for 
herself in her own way.

The three years spent with Sweep Tosho. In 
that not-so-short time, perhaps she, too, 
has grown up a little.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ngggh! Why—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Why are our rooms separated!? Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even though we're having a sleepover, we 
can't even stay up chatting at night!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
The room is huge, Japanese-style, and the 
corners are kind of dim and spooky!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I'm scared...! I tried to 
bear with it at first, I really did! —But 
it's just so, super boring!
choice_data_list: ...Shall we chat until you get sleepy?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... you're probably bored anyway, 
familiar! Fine, I'll keep you company 
until you get sleepy!

And then—the two of us spent a relaxing 
time chatting until we grew sleepy.

Three years. Some things change, while 
others remain the same.

"It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Sweep Tosho..."
